test: external test of the frozen ANKYRA 2.1 on UNICON (La Trobe University, five campuses, Victoria, Australia); protocol frozen before any consumption value was read; amendment 01 (causal filling of gaps of at most 6 h in the inputs, written after the missingness was seen and before any forecast)

primary.what: monthly energy error vs TimesFM 2.5, upper end of 95% unit-and-month interval < 0

secondary.what: hourly error vs TimesFM 2.5, lower end <= 0

licence_note: UNICON is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (research use only); its data are not redistributed here
diagnostic: dense short gaps leave few complete pseudo-origin windows: ANKYRA used on average 0.51 of 6 pseudo-origin pairs, so its weights stayed close to their priors
